reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and link.findOrCreateBank, the unlink field reset is extracted into clearAccountBankLink and reused by unlinkAccount and the takeover path, and the balance handling joins the existing Akahu branch.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions and fintegraAccounts of akahuAccounts with only the server constant changed, and the same assertCanLinkBankAccount block is pasted into all six provider link functions instead of living in the shared link path.

placement.why: Link guards sit in accounts/app.ts next to linkBankSyncAccount, download logic in sync.ts, server path in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, matching the existing provider layout.

scope.why: Adds an unrequested `fintegra-accounts` listing handler and reorders an unrelated import in schedules/app.ts; the rest serves the four steps.

maintainability.why: The link rules are concentrated in two helpers, but the guard must be remembered in every provider function, the holder lookup runs twice (guard and takeover), and another copy-pasted per-provider download function adds to the pile.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link functions still delegate to linkBankSyncAccount; the new provider uses the existing provider plumbing.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated Fintegra download/accounts functions and the per-provider guard calls are open copies, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains a `replaceExistingLink` parameter and an `if (replaceExistingLink)` holder-clearing branch; the eligibility guard is not inside it but called separately from each of the six provider link functions.
